seo.title: Rhynie Drive | Chantier Construction — Crio Creatives
seo.description: Living room, kitchen and pantry, dining area, guestroom and bedrooms renovation proposal at Rhynie Drive, Montego Bay, Jamaica. Interior design and visualization by Crio Creatives for Chantier Construction.

hero.description: Living room, kitchen, pantry, dining and bedroom renovations.

sections.title: Master Bathroom.
paragraphs: A cohesive, warm-toned bathroom renovation with refined architectural and lighting details.
Creation of an arched entrance to the shower, replacement light fixtures above the vanity mirrors, and a single consistent tile treatment across the bathroom floor.
